subject.title: Dashboard: widget publish + community registry — the ecosystem half of the gallery

question: Should dashboard widget publishing and registry browsing be a bundled OpenClaw dashboard feature, a ClawHub-backed package model, or an external experiment until the base dashboard stack lands?
rationale: The request creates a new dashboard distribution and trust boundary, and automation cannot choose whether OpenClaw should own the registry surface or what provenance/security model maintainers want.

options.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Registry
options.body: Keep this issue open and require publish/browse/install to use ClawHub or package-style trust metadata plus explicit widget approvals after the dashboard base settles.

options.title: Prototype Externally First
options.body: Ask contributors to prove the registry/publish shape as an external plugin or ClawHub package before sponsoring a bundled dashboard surface.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Close or pause the widget registry path if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to own a dashboard widget ecosystem surface right now.

recommendation.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Registry
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require publish/browse/install to use ClawHub or package-style trust metadata plus explicit widget approvals after the dashboard base settles.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest history-backed bundled Control UI tab precedent and product-routing guardrail context for deciding core versus ClawHub scope.
